title: Curo loop (Tagliaferri-Barbellino GPX) + Valbondione descent
terrain: loop ~19km, ~1250m D+ / D-, max 2596m; then ~7km / -900m exit. Total ~2200m descent on the day

steps.target: Z1-Z2, run flats, hike climbs, easy on loop descents

steps.note: full lunch stop back at Curo before the exit descent

steps.target: Z1, hike-only descent to Valbondione, poles

coachNotes: GO/NO-GO at wake-up: elevated morning HR or feverish feeling = skip the loop, descend and go home. Biggest eccentric day since March (~2200m D-), so the ITB rules are absolute: poles on every descent, short stride, high cadence. Bail-out is built in - any lateral knee signal on the loop, cut it short back to Curo and take the exit slow. The final descent is on tired legs: hike it, do not run it. Fuel 60-80g carbs/h from the start.
